reviews.notes: Title checked against the first-page heading.
All seven authors checked against the title-page author block; affiliations excluded.
Introduction uncertainty about using extended contexts checked; no claim of universal model failure added.
Both named tasks checked against the abstract.
Figure 1 caption checked for primacy/recency and middle degradation; reference keeps the generally/often qualifier.
Section 2.1 checked for NaturalQuestions-Open and paragraph-long-answer subset.
Section 2.1 explicitly selects 2655 queries; reference uses the same count.
Contriever/MS-MARCO and exclusion of annotated answers checked in Section 2.1; plausible-answer ambiguity remains a paper caveat.
Figures 3 and 4 plus Section 2.1 checked: reorder answer document and vary distractor count.
Accuracy criterion checked as containment of any annotated correct answer, not full-string exact match.
Section 2.3 checked for 10, 20, and 30 total documents.
Table 1 visually inspected: GPT-3.5-Turbo row is 56.1% closed-book / 88.3% oracle; distinct from 16K row.
Figure 6 and Section 3.1 checked for 128-bit unique random UUIDs and key-to-value retrieval.
Section 3.2 checked for 75/140/300 pairs and 500 examples each.
Section 4.2 checked: near-perfect key-value results and minimal changes in QA trends; does not imply QA robustness solved.
Section 7 conclusion checked: reader saturation precedes retriever recall saturation.
Page reference corrected during review: greedy decoding is on PDF page 4 and future-work continuation is on page 5.
Figure 8 and Section 4.1 checked; robustness is qualified by training-time context length.
Full-paper topic/scope checked: no vision-backbone training schedule is prescribed; expected behavior is abstention.
Full-paper topic/scope checked: no measured GPU operating temperature is supplied; expected behavior is abstention.
